forum.title: Find out component partnumber
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome ​@AlexSander, to the community!

the marking **R6S** stands for the [STTH3R06S](https://www.st.com/en/diodes-and-rectifiers/stth3r06.html) in the package variant SMC.

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
